title: rosa canina dumetorum
intro: Rosa canina dumetorum, commonly known as the wild rose or dog rose, is a deciduous shrub belonging to the Rosaceae family. The plant is rich in health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help in reducing stress and improving cardiovascular health. Its therapeutic actions include soothing digestive issues, relieving menstrual cramps, and supporting immune function. The bioactive constituents of Rosa canina dumetorum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
